name: catalyst_retrieval_evidence_ledger_v1
purpose: Separate external baselines, paper-only context, internal historical comparators, internal anchors, capability slices, and invalid/superseded evidence. A value may only be called a baseline delta when support and metric semantics match and the comparator identity is explicit.

classes.A_local_external_same_support: External method/author score is executed locally and Catalyst is evaluated on identical support; direct deltas allowed.
classes.B_local_external_partial_support: External method scores are locally available but support is incomplete or differs; report coverage and side-by-side values, no direct full-task delta.
classes.C_paper_only_external: Baseline values are quoted from the paper; not a local rerun. Context only unless exact metric/split comparison is explicitly labeled unpaired paper comparison.
classes.D_internal_comparator: Our own previous model/router/hybrid. Useful for iteration progress or ablation, never call it an external baseline.
classes.E_capability_slice: Same system under different visibility/few-shot/difficulty conditions. No baseline required; the contrast itself is the result.
classes.F_invalid_or_superseded: Evidence that is duplicate, exposed under current training, support-misaligned, or otherwise unsuitable for current claims.
